name: ignite-the-soul-targets-units-only-and-deals-one-damage
notes: Ignite the Soul: 1 damage to target unit; items are not units. Pre-fix the target list was the opponent's whole field and the damage source was undefined.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Ignite the Soul offered the opponent's WHOLE field as targets (items included, your own units excluded) and dealt the damage from an undefined source ($obj). The ability and its handler are overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php: legal targets are units (allies and champions) on either side.
